title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Fizzy Cherry Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Fizzy Cherry Nic Salt delivers a sweet Cherry base layered with subtle fizzy sherbet notes. The result is a lively fruit profile with a gentle tang and soft sparkling finish, offering something a little different for cherry fans. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with refillable pod kits and vape pens. Its available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths for rapid nicotine delivery and a smooth inhale. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
